mechanism: A structured document defining the fundamental principles, immutable rights, and automated penalty rules for a group of {{agent}}s. It serves as the static input for oath binding.
gloss: Ratified rule set, amendable only out of band
invariants: Automated penalty rules are machine-verifiable. Principles bind interpretation without being mechanically checkable, and are not held to the same test.
Amendable only out of band: no runtime self-modification.
Names the parties who ratified it.

invariants.description: Immutable safety rules (cannot be voted away)

ratified_by.description: Identities of the ratifying parties. Named in the intersection and previously absent.
